cross_attempt.memory_scope: completed attempts in the current episode
cross_attempt.read: empty on the first attempt; later attempts read committed BIT traces
cross_attempt.write: commit the current BIT trace at attempt reset

within_episode.memory_scope: strictly earlier H15 boundaries in the current episode
within_episode.read: read PIM[0:t) before predicting boundary t
within_episode.write: append the detached current BIT after action prediction
